task.name: Model routing
task.description: Input is a routing signal vector: a domain, a complexity band, and the list of structure and keyword signals that fired. Choose the cheapest model expected to answer the request correctly. Larger models cost more, so route up only when the signals call for it. Anything no rule matches falls back to the strongest model, so a rule is only worth writing when it can safely route below that.

rules.name: business_unknown_domain
rules.description: Route all business domain inputs with unknown reasoning to the target model (no counter‑example observed).

rules.name: fuzzy_sensitive_keywords_rule
rules.description: Matches any input where the signals list contains the token 'fuzzy_sensitive_keywords'. This token is unique to the target class in the training data.

rules.name: first_then_flow_rule
rules.description: Match inputs with the same domain/reasoning constraints where the signals contain 'first_then_flow'.

rules.name: code_keywords_rule
rules.description: Match inputs where the signals list contains 'code_keywords' together with the required domain and reasoning values.

rules.name: single_atmost_one_question
rules.description: Matches inputs with exactly one signal 'at_most_one_question' for any domain except business, routing to the cheap 7B model.

rules.name: none_psychology
rules.description: When the signal list is exactly 'none' for psychology domain, route to 7B.

rules.name: none_nan
rules.description: Nan domain with exactly 'none' signal routes to the 7B model (previously sent to 1.5B).

rules.name: low_qd_nan
rules.description: Nan domain with only low_question_density signal routes to the 7B model (previously mis‑routed to 32B).

rules.name: low_qd_other
rules.description: Business, law, or psychology with only 'low_question_density' routes to the 14B model.

rules.name: urgent_nan
rules.description: Nan domain with 'urgent_keywords' routes to the 1.5B model (more specific than generic urgent rule).

rules.name: urgent_law_health
rules.description: Law or health domain with 'urgent_keywords' routes to the 14B model.

rules.name: urgent_business_psych
rules.description: Business or psychology domain with 'urgent_keywords' routes to the 7B model.

rules.name: business_atmost_low
rules.description: Business domain with both at_most_one_question and low_question_density signals (exactly these two) routes to the 14B model (cheapest that handles this combo).

rules.name: law_atmost_low
rules.description: Law domain with both at_most_one_question and low_question_density signals (exactly these two) routes to the 14B model.

rules.name: business_code_extra
rules.description: Business domain where code_keywords appear together with any other signal routes to 1.5B (cheaper than default 7B for code_keywords).

rules.name: psychology_atmost_low
rules.description: Psychology domain with both at_most_one_question and low_question_density signals routes to the 1.5B model.

rules.name: nan_atmost_low
rules.description: Nan domain with both at_most_one_question and low_question_density signals (exactly these two) routes to the cheapest 1.5B model.

rules.name: business_single_atmost
rules.description: Business domain with only the at_most_one_question signal (no other signals) routes to the cheapest 1.5B model.
